text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Jordanian press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Tight 1997 budget of 1.916 billion dinars ($2.71 billion). Revenues will be 1.86 billion dinars, with a 225 million dinar deficit.
- Flash floods close roads in southern areas around Petra and Wadi Musa. One dead and four people missing.
- Release expected within days of prisoners amnestied by King Hussein earlier this month. Government committee has finished studying 1,549 cases eligible for pardon.
- Prime Minister Kabariti discusses Spain's peacemaking role in the Middle East with Prime Minister Aznar during his visit to Madrid.
- Royal Wings flew first Jordanian flight to Israel's Haifa airport on Monday.
- Local gold price falls to 7.6 dinars for a 21 carat gramme, traders say slump will continue.
- Head of central tenders committee says tightening up implementation of regulations for companies in construction sector.
- Jordan, Spain urge collective effort to revive peace process.
